scope: Documentation-only access-action review; no provider queries, account creation or outreach.

documents.basis: official documentation returned by search index; no live catalog query
documents.finding: Personal free api.data.gov key required for automated v4 catalog queries; X-Api-Key header; 1,000 requests/hour. DEMO_KEY is for initial exploration.

documents.basis: official signup page returned by search index
documents.finding: Public API-key signup page exists. No form submitted.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool
documents.finding: Public key form asks for organization, email and acceptance of terms. No form submitted.

documents.basis: official 2026 documentation returned by search index
documents.finding: Current Census guidance says all data queries require an API key and directs users to request a free key. Older no-key quotas should not be substituted.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool
documents.finding: Free Europeana account needed to request/manage API keys; documented APIs support public app/service use. Personal and project keys are distinct.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool; page updated 2026-10-21
documents.finding: Account registration/confirmation precedes key request. Project-key option provides increased access; no approval outcome or current limits tested.

documents.basis: indexed official policy; direct read returned HTTP403
documents.finding: Indexed policy documents POST https://api.dp.la/v2/api_key/<email>, with key automatically delivered by email. Current endpoint functionality was not tested.

documents.basis: indexed official help; direct read returned HTTP503
documents.finding: Official help describes account and API-request functions. Current account setup and LGD resource API are unverified.
Official resource page advertises Generate API Key. This does not establish that every dataset, including LGD, has a supported API.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool; last reviewed 2026-05-01
documents.finding: Anyone may request an assigned read-only API key; Catalog_API@nara.gov is the published API contact. Default 10,000 queries/month. Terms prohibit scraping/downloading entire catalog via API and say not to cache/store returned content; evidence retention needs clarification.

documents.basis: saved registry document plus indexed official product content at webflow.semanticscholar.org; canonical direct read returned403
documents.finding: Public API-key request form; anonymous users share throttling; advertised introductory authenticated allowance 1 request/second. A key request is not proof of approval, access or permitted app use.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool
documents.finding: Default license describes internal noncommercial research/education/model-evaluation uses. Expanded uses including commercial use are directed to the API-key form. MyBookshelf public search should be explicitly described in the request.

documents.basis: indexed official API documentation; other official product pages rendered JS shells
documents.finding: Free API requires a real contact email; DOI lookup remains documented. Indexed current docs state keyword search retired 2026-09-18 and direct keyword queries to OpenAlex. No DOI/query attempt made.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool
documents.finding: Commercial use requires contacting repec@repec.org first. Website scraping discouraged; publisher ReDIF archives and OAI/rsync alternatives documented. Neither contact nor queries performed.

documents.basis: direct primary-page read via web tool
documents.finding: Terms prohibit scraping/bulk downloading SWAYAM site content. No supported external metadata API was established; learner registration does not remove this restriction.

documents.basis: saved current registry evidence; web tool reports robots exclusion, no new page read
documents.finding: Saved terms section2(j) prohibits automated retrieval/indexing; saved robots disallows /api/. Published CKAN links do not resolve that conflict. Permission request is a recommendation, not evidence that an exception is available.

failed_reads.outcome: not accessible through web tool; no current permission rule established
